tasks.task: Plan offers and events that fill the quietest nights

items.when: When the same night, day or season is empty and you need offers and events that still make money
When you want three offers side by side, each with its food or drink cost checked
When the owner reaches for a plain price cut, to get gift, bundle and pre-order ideas instead
Before an offer goes out, to work out the real cost per portion and what each cover leaves
When a discount is planned, to find the deepest cut the margin allows and the wording to use
When the offer is a thin discount and needs more value for the guest at the same cost

tasks.task: Write menu descriptions for a new or seasonal menu

items.when: When the kitchen's notes are in and you need short dish lines with allergen lines from its records
When the menu also needs header lines, section notes and a drinks list in the same voice
When a header or signature dish line is flat, to get three versions a guest would remember
When a dish line could be on any menu, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite
When the words list ingredients but say nothing of how the dish feels to eat

tasks.task: Reply to a batch of guest reviews

items.when: Each week, to reply to new reviews in the owner's voice with risky ones held for a yes
When reviews span Google and booking sites, or one may break the platform's rules
When a guest complaint needs a warm reply, a fair fix and a note for the manager
Before a reply to a complaint is posted, to check every promise and the tone
When the batch is large, to check each reply and flag complaints that keep coming back

tasks.task: Promote one event from first post to last call

items.when: When one event has a date and you need every post, email, listing and reminder for it
When the date is set and you need what goes out each week up to the night
When the event is ticketed and needs a price, early-bird terms and how to show seats left
When the event line is flat, to get five short headlines that each take a new angle
When the event needs a poster for the door, the bar and the window
When the pack is drafted, to find its weakest lines and fix the booking ask

tasks.task: Launch a new menu, dish or drinks release

items.when: When the launch date is set and the owner needs the week-by-week countdown
When the release is limited, to plan early access and deadlines that are true
When several people work on the launch and need one brief and a weekly calendar

tasks.task: Plan and write a month of local social posts

items.when: When there is no post plan, to get topics from what guests really say and ask
When you need a rolling calendar with captions in the venue's voice, ready to approve
When a Reel needs an opening, to get ten hooks checked for length and first shot
When guests already post photos, to plan how to earn more and reuse them with consent
When last week's numbers are in, to plan next week from what worked
When the owner's team will make the post graphics themselves from templates
When every post asks for a booking and none gives the follower anything first

tasks.task: Write tasting notes and product copy for a drinks release

items.when: When the maker's notes are in and you need tasting notes, a short story and a trade sheet
When the notes must match the taproom board, the label and the shop page
Before writing, to pull true facts from maker and supplier notes that rivals never state
When the release sells online and needs a shop description with the right claims and units
When the one-line note is forgettable, to get three versions to choose from
When a note is all adjectives, to test it and get a line a drinker can picture

tasks.task: Pitch a drink to bars, restaurants and shops

items.when: When a buyer needs one page with the notes, the story, sizes and trade terms
When you target one shop or chain and need the order of steps to reach its buyer
When you need a short personal first email to a named bar or shop buyer
Before quoting a trade price, to see the margin per unit after the stockist's cut and freight

tasks.task: Write a release email series for a club or list

items.when: When a release has a close date and you need the run of emails planned to the last call
When the plan is set and each email needs writing block by block from the release facts
When an email is written, to get subject lines in several angles to pick from
When club members get first access, to set the early window and deadlines truthfully
Before each send, to get cuts, a score and a ship or fix verdict

tasks.task: Write a guest newsletter or a text to the list

items.when: When the venue has news and guest questions and needs one useful issue in its voice
When the message goes by SMS or WhatsApp and needs consent rules built in
When the issue is drafted, to compare subject lines in several angles
Before the send, to get cuts, a score and a ship or fix verdict on the draft
Before a text goes out, to check its cost and the rules it must meet
When the list came from bookings or wifi sign-ins and you doubt who agreed to marketing

tasks.task: Win back guests who have stopped coming

items.when: When you know how often regulars return, to time a win-back run to that gap
When the first win-back email is drafted, to try several openings
Before the run goes live, to score each email and fix the weak one

tasks.task: Fix how the venue shows on Google and booking sites

items.when: When menus, hours, prices or booking links differ between Google, booking sites and the site
When you need a ranked fix list for the Google profile and where name and address differ
When the site needs markup so search shows the menu, hours, events or price range

tasks.task: Check prices, fees and offer wording before publishing

items.when: Before room rates, menus, tickets or ads go out, to check fees and charges are shown properly
When several offers run at once, to find clashes and settle one true offer line
When an ad, page or email makes a drinks or price claim, to flag risky lines with safer ones

tasks.task: Roll out a menu, price or hours change everywhere

items.when: When a menu, price, fee or opening hours change and every place it shows must match
When one fact changes, to list every post, page and email that still shows the old one
When regulars or club members should hear about a price rise from the owner first

tasks.task: Run the weekly venue marketing routine

items.when: Each week, to cover posts, reviews, listings and offers in about half an hour of the owner's time
When this week's posts should follow what worked last week

tasks.task: Get more guest reviews without breaking the rules

items.when: When you need to know what each review platform allows before asking guests
When you need the moment to ask, the words to use and how to handle a bad review
When reviews pile up, to rank praise and complaints with guests' own words

tasks.task: Design a loyalty scheme, wine club or membership

items.when: When regulars deserve perks that are not discounts, with a small test first
When a club or membership needs tier prices and reasons to move up
Before launch, to test the scheme's sums against what it costs and who it reaches
When the plan rewards guests who already come and does nothing to reach new ones

tasks.task: Sell private hire, group bookings and catering

items.when: When the venue needs a private hire or group page with proof, answers and one clear ask
When that page needs an opening, to get five headlines with a pick
When enquiries arrive, to qualify each one and draft a reply the owner sends
When you write to local firms and planners who may book a party or a room
When the page or pack is drafted, to find and fix its weakest parts

tasks.task: Win local press, partners and creators

items.when: When there is real news, to get a media list, pitch emails and a press kit outline
When a nearby business could share an event or offer and you need the pitch
When you invite creators in, to plan the invite, tracking and which posts to reuse
Before a free meal is offered, to check a creator's followers live near the venue

tasks.task: Write a small local ad for an offer or event

items.when: When the owner boosts an offer or event and needs ad text and hooks to test
When the ad is an image, to get its words in two or three versions to compare
Before an ad that shows alcohol or a price goes live, to check it against the ad rules

tasks.task: Plan food and drink photos and short videos

items.when: When a photographer comes in, to list each shot and where it will be used
When you plan Reels, to get opening lines and first shots to film

tasks.task: Grow direct bookings for a hotel or rooms

items.when: When rates, free booking links and room details differ between Google and booking sites
When you need room nights and net revenue by channel after agent commission
When the owner asks what to charge and which channel mix fills rooms at the best rate
When a room package or book-direct page needs proof, answers and one ask

tasks.task: Plan the year's seasonal campaigns and gift vouchers

items.when: When a season such as Christmas or Mother's Day needs a brief and a weekly calendar
When the season needs an offer that is not a price cut, such as a gift or bundle
When one seasonal offer runs across email and text and needs a send calendar

tasks.task: Report the month's results to the owner

items.when: In the first week of the month, for the look-back on what filled seats and what did not
When the numbers are gathered and the owner needs trends, wins, misses and next steps
When email and text numbers are in, to see what broke and what to repeat
When the report should show what guests praised and complained about that month

always.when: Before the first job for a venue, to turn its menus, posts and replies into voice rules
Before copy goes out, to fix off-voice words without touching the facts
When copy states an award, an origin or a number you cannot trace to the venue
Before a menu, sheet or email is printed or sent, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When an offer or event depends on dish costs, staffing or what the kitchen can serve
When the menu, poster or sell sheet must be laid out and made ready for print
When the venue needs local search, listings and citations fixed beyond its Google profile
When a review dispute, a fake review wave or a public complaint needs a case built
When a drinks maker needs a stockist plan, trade terms and distributor outreach
When an event needs a run sheet, suppliers and on-the-night roles, not only promotion

gaps: No library item writes menu descriptions, menu header lines or tasting notes; only the kit covers them
No library item does menu engineering: which dishes to feature, where to place them and how to show prices, from sales mix
No library item checks allergen and calorie lines against the kitchen's records
No library item checks alcohol promotion rules: age gating, happy hour limits and responsible drinking wording
No library item covers Google Business Profile for restaurants and hotels: menu editor, reserve links and hotel free booking links; the listing item is built for trades
No library item audits a booking site or delivery app listing, or checks rate parity between direct and agent prices
No library item lays out a trade sell sheet or line card for bars and shops
No library item builds a private hire or group booking pack with capacities, menus and minimum spend
No library item plans a gift voucher campaign or a birthday and anniversary message run for guests
No library item checks that mandatory fees and service charges are shown in the total price; only the kit prompt does
No library item gives two differently toned replies to one hard review for the owner to choose between
No library item covers wine club or taproom programmes: allocation releases, club shipment emails and weekday visit drivers
No library item reads booking data such as covers by night, no-shows and spend per head to find the quiet slots
